title: At the Bus Stop
text:
Anna meets her friend Tom at the bus stop. They say hello to each other. Tom asks how Anna is. She says she is fine.

Then they take the bus together. The bus is big and red. They sit near the window. Tom says that school is far away.

questions.text: Why do Anna and Tom take the bus together?
options: They are going the same way
They want to buy a bus
They do not know each other

questions.text: What kind of relationship do Anna and Tom probably have?

vocabulary.definition: a big vehicle that carries many people
a person you like and know well
a glass part in a wall that lets in light

paragraph_translations: Anna spotyka swojego przyjaciela Toma na przystanku autobusowym. Mówią sobie cześć. Tom pyta Annę, jak się czuje. Ona mówi, że czuje się dobrze.
Potem jadą razem autobusem. Autobus jest duży i czerwony. Siadają blisko okna. Tom mówi, że szkoła jest daleko.
